10k.note: Abivax S.A. is a French company; SEC registrant filing 20-F annual reports. Pipeline content here is sourced from corporate site and clinicaltrials.gov.

website.note: Lead asset obefazimod (ABX464) in Phase 3 for ulcerative colitis (ABTECT program; induction readout in 2025) and Phase 2b for Crohn's disease (ENHANCE-CD).

ctgov.note: Four active sponsor-led P1-P3 trials: ABTECT-Maintenance Phase 3 (NCT05535946), Long-Term Phase 2 (NCT05177835), Crohn's Phase 2 (NCT06456593), and minitablet Phase 1 PK (NCT07453784). ABTECT-1 and ABTECT-2 induction studies (NCT05507203, NCT05507216) are completed (June 2025).

pipeline.modality: Small molecule oral; first-in-class miR-124 enhancer (splicing modulator)

indications.indication: Moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (induction)
indications.trial_name: ABTECT-1 / ABTECT-2 (ABX464 Treatment Evaluation for UC Therapy)
indications.trial_design: Two parallel global Phase 3 induction studies; randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-ranging
indications.trial_status: COMPLETED (primary completion 2025-06-24); topline induction data reported Q3 2025

indications.indication: Moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (maintenance)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled maintenance phase following ABTECT-1/2 responders
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (primary completion 2026-04); maintenance data expected Q2 2026

indications.indication: Moderately to severely active Crohn's disease

indications.trial_name: Obefazimod minitablet PK / relative bioavailability / palatability

excluded_preclinical: Follow-on miR-124 modulator series (research stage, candidate selection planned 2026)
excluded_legacy_terminated: ABX464 Phase 2b/3 in Crohn's (NCT03905109, WITHDRAWN 2022; superseded by ENHANCE-CD)
ABX464 Phase 2 in HIV (NCT02452242, NCT02735863, NCT02990325) — completed legacy program
ABX464 Phase 2 in rheumatoid arthritis (NCT03813199, NCT04049448) — completed, not advanced
ABX196 Phase 1/2 in HCC (NCT03897543) — non-core program
ABX203 Phase 2/3 hepatitis B (NCT02249988) — completed legacy

summary_counts.note_on_counts: phase counts reflect active obefazimod indications/programs; the asset count is 1 (obefazimod)
